description: US product recalls in one schema from openFDA enforcement reports (food, drug, device) and CPSC: date, product, firm, reason, FDA Class I/II/III mapped to high/medium/low (CPSC severity is derived from the hazard text), distribution and states, and the official link. Filter by keyword, since date (default 30 days), source and classification; up to 100 rows. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

classification.description: Class I, Class II, Class III or high, medium, low

q.description: Keyword in the product or firm name

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default 30 days ago, at most one year back

name: recalls
title: Recalls
